description.en-US: Bossuet's Discourse on Universal History, written for the Dauphin: the twelve epochs from the Creation to Charlemagne, the continuity of religion, and the revolutions of empires, in James Elphinston's English version.
description.pt-BR: O Discurso sobre a História Universal de Bossuet, escrito para o Delfim: as doze épocas da Criação a Carlos Magno, a continuidade da religião e as revoluções dos impérios, na versão inglesa de James Elphinston.

sources.edition: An Universal History, tr. James Elphinston (London, 1778), Google Books scan on the Internet Archive, full-text OCR. Split by the work's three parts only; chapter divisions inside the parts are not recoverable from the OCR.
sources.description: Cut at the three parts (Epochs, Continuation of Religion, Revolutions of Empires); the OCR carries marginal date notes and scan noise. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Jacques-Bénigne Bossuet died in 1704 and the edition is of 1778, so the text is public domain.

title.en-US: Part I: The Epochs, or Ages of the World
Part II: The Continuation of Religion
Part III: The Revolutions of Empires
